correctness.rationale: From the actual 24-edge C12^2 graph, independently enumerated all 36 perfect matchings and exactly 1,412 nonempty extendible faces (f=(24,180,476,480,216,36)). Reconstructed the 696-pair sequential acyclic face matching and topologically sorted all 5,004 oriented Hasse covers, leaving one 0-cell and nineteen 2-cells; Forman implies integral wedge of 19 S^2 with no 1-cell attachments. Independently computed oriented-face Lefschetz traces for all 24 dihedral elements: rotations (19,-1,1,-1,1,-1,-5,-1,1,-1,1,-1), reflections alternating 1,-3; averaging gives fixed ranks 0 for full group and 1 for rotations. Non-shellability follows from pure dimension five with nonzero reduced H2. Checked actual RESULT.md and verify.py Git blobs; no extrapolation to other antiprisms.
